package.name: auv_pressure
package.description: Driver for the Blue Robotics Bar02 pressure/depth sensor (MS5837-02BA, I2C), using Blue Robotics' own official ms5837-python library directly (installed via pip from GitHub, not vendored as a git submodule). Publishes depth as PoseWithCovarianceStamped on /localization/depth_pose, matching the pose0 placeholder already stubbed in auv_localization's ekf.yaml.
